notes: First real piece of the Pattern Engine (financial planning direction): the AI chat's forecast is no longer one raw extrapolated number - it now separates confirmed recurring income (3+ regular payments) from estimated from variable/irregular income, and confirmed vs estimated recurring expenses, each clearly labeled. New: you can mark a transaction as a transfer between your own accounts (tap it > toggle) so it's excluded from income/expense patterns. New: if you name a habit after something you're trying to cut back on (e.g. "No eating out"), the AI chat can now mention how that category's spend is trending alongside it. Needs at least a month of transaction history before it will forecast anything - by design, not a bug.
